verdict.line: You win if you land E (Apprehend) pulls and close the lane out before level 13; you lose if it drags into the mid game, where the matchup flattens back to a 49.9% coinflip despite your lane and solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Darius out-trades Gwen at point-blank range because Hemorrhage stacks faster than her passive's magic damage ticks, and E (Apprehend, range 535) yanks her out of kiting position before she can set up Skip 'n Slash. Her counter is W (Hallowed Mist), which makes her untargetable by everything except enemies who walk into the mist — a 22-18s cooldown escape valve that can null a pull attempt if she times it right, which is why the overall win rate sits at an even 49.9% across 2,004 games despite the stated lane and solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.what: Skip 'n Slash partially refunds its cooldown on hit and grants Attack Speed, range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. Don't facetank the follow-up autos — back off and let the buff expire before re-engaging.

yourWindow.when: your E is up, her W is down
yourWindow.what: Land E (Apprehend) to pull her into melee, then W (Crippling Strike) to slow and lock her in while Hemorrhage stacks climb. This is your clean all-in — once she gets Hallowed Mist back up she can simply step into it and become untargetable to your follow-up.

powerCurve.note: R execute outpaces her mist sustain
E dash kiting offsets your pulls

start.why: This is the universal start (100% pick, 46.2% WR over 13 games) and gives the sustain to win extended trades where you're stacking Hemorrhage through her passive's magic damage ticks.

boots.why: Dominant pick at 92.3% (41.7% WR over 12 games) — the magic resist blunts her passive's bonus magic damage and R (Needlework) poke over a long lane.

core.why: The active haste and lethality close the gap on a kiting Gwen before she can get Skip 'n Slash's range and attack speed buff rolling.
Her entire kit is magic damage — passive on-hit, Q true/magic hybrid, R magic — so this directly answers her damage profile while adding move speed to keep pace with her dash.
Built-up move speed turns into a shoulder-charge that closes distance on her E resets and gives you the durability to survive her kiting phase.

situational.when: she's building burst and you need tenacity plus a damage shield to survive her engage
you want the bleed-out-damage conversion to out-sustain her passive's health-based magic damage
you'd rather have a built-in slow to lock down her dash instead of going Youmuu's first
she's leaning hard on Q (Snip Snip!) and autos rather than magic burst and you want the flat damage reduction instead

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended melee trades with Gwen let Conqueror ramp fully, converting into the adaptive force and healing you need to outlast her sustain. Master-tier Darius players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) in 352 games — that suits a more mobile, snowball-the-early-levels playstyle built around chaining E pulls into kills rather than grinding trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is both the most-picked (69.2%) and best-performing combo (55.6% WR) — Ghost closes the distance Gwen's Skip 'n Slash opens up and lets you stick through her kiting window to land the E (Apprehend) pull.

playing.title: Pull before mist pops
playing.detail: Use E (Apprehend) the instant she's in its 535 range. If she's already inside Hallowed Mist, you can't target her with it from outside — you'd have to walk in first, losing the window.

playing.title: All-in hard at levels 3-5
playing.detail: Once E-W-Q is online you out-damage her before her kit has an answer beyond Hallowed Mist on an 18-22s cooldown. This is your best window before her Needlework poke exists.

playing.title: Track Hemorrhage stacks for R
playing.detail: Watch your passive stack count on her — R (Noxian Guillotine)'s true damage scales per stack, so look for the moment she's near 5 stacks to confirm a kill.

playing.title: Don't chase through her E reset
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash refunds cooldown on hit and buffs her attack speed and range for a few seconds after. If she lands it on you, disengage rather than trading into the buffed window.

playing.title: Hold E for all-ins, not pokes
playing.detail: Apprehend's cooldown is long (26-16s by rank) — don't burn it to interrupt a single Q poke. Save it for a real all-in when her W is down.

playing.title: Close the lane before level 13
playing.detail: Your curve note shows her on-hit scaling catching up from level 14 on. Use your early/mid lane lead to shove, kill, or force recalls rather than letting the lane stabilize into late game.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and win-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; several paths have small samples (as few as 1-2 games), so treat the exact item order as directional rather than gospel. The matchup mechanics, timing windows, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the ability interactions.
